status: Approved interface, private implementation in progress; no production edit.

row.provisional: bool; one current round at most

reasoning.durationMs: optional measured milliseconds; omit legacy unknown

tool.toolCallId: provider call ID, scoped to assistant batch
tool.name: tool name
tool.inputText: partial or complete raw JSON string

invariants: One assistant row per provider round, with stable IDs across provisional retention. Tool result messages merge into the corresponding batch-local tool part instead of creating duplicate rows.
displayHistory and displayMessages are pure projections; neither mutates input messages or source caller values.
New UI data is persisted as versioned metadata.display, never inside ade_native. Existing attachments/fileReads metadata remains preserved.
Old histories derive deterministic stable keys and best available ordered parts from canonical/native values; missing timing is not invented.
displayChanged fires after coherent state changes, with QObject lifetime/generation barriers. UI owns16ms coalescing and disclosure state.

Reasoning-only failed/canceled partial may persist as explicitly versioned UI-only empty assistant row without native signatures. Provider omission requires marker AND empty canonical text AND no tool calls/native payload/attachments; malformed marker cannot hide real content.
Failure/cancel replacement/destruction callbacks must retain the current production queued reply/preparer/history acceptance guards.
validationPlan: All four provider protocols, ordered multi-round text/reason/tool streams and partial input fragments
Stable IDs and no duplicate provisional after retention, restart projection, reused call IDs in separate batches
Reasoning-only interrupted persistence and strict UI-only wire omission
Provider request equivalence with UI metadata for all four protocols; signed/native objects unchanged
Cancellation/replacement/destruction from displayChanged plus existing observer suites
